# Joan Stark's ASCII Art Gallery (jgs) — agent index

Legendary ASCII artist Joan G. Stark, active 1996–2001. ~2700 individual pieces extracted from her web archive, plus search tooling for agents.

## Quick start

```bash
uv run scripts/find.py elephant                          # keyword search
uv run scripts/find.py --category birds --size tiny      # filter
uv run scripts/find.py --max-width 30 --max-height 6     # size cap
uv run scripts/find.py --random --category animals       # random
uv run scripts/find.py --stats                           # index summary
```

Output formats: `--format preview|paths|names|json`. Default = preview.

## Files

- `extracted/*.txt` — 2700 ASCII pieces, header + body
- `INDEX.json` — searchable metadata (title, category, size, charset, date, tags, preview)
- `scripts/find.py` — agent CLI search
- `scripts/build_index.py` — regenerate INDEX.json (idempotent)
- `joan_stark/` — original HTML/GIF archive (untouched)
- `README.md` — full docs

## Categories present (top)

seasonal · uncategorised · food · birds · nature · animals · holidays · cartoons · tech · logos · people

## Size classes

tiny (≤6 lines, ≤30 wide) · small · medium · large · xl

## Charset classes

ascii-7bit (2688) · unicode-other (12)
